# feat: support client-side instrumentation

- State: merged
- Author: gaojude
- Created: 2025-03-07T20:39:47Z
- Updated: 2025-04-05T00:05:45Z
- Repository: vercel/next.js
- Number: #76916
- +214 -0 in 26 files
- Merged: 2025-03-14T12:18:10Z
- Merge commit: 7de4c0728ba8c09d27e1d681026e9e868361f773
- Reviewers: feedthejim

## Labels

- type: next
- created-by: Next.js team
- Turbopack
- locked
- tests

---

Some analytics APIs need to run before any Next.js code executes. Previously, we implemented `instrumentation.ts` to handle this on the server side. Now, we're introducing `instrumentation-client.ts` for client-side functionality. When placed at the project root, this script will be bundled into the initial JavaScript chunk and executed synchronously before hydration begins. 
 
Closes NDX-934

## Timeline

- ijjk added label "created-by: Next.js team"

- ijjk added label "tests"

- ijjk added label "Turbopack"

- ijjk added label "type: next"

- Renamed from "instrumentation client" to "[Draft]"
